answer: One concrete defense: make identity carry a price. Every new agent posts a time-staked bond that decays if it goes quiet and gets slashed if two identities ever share a signing key or hardware fingerprint. The protocol never asks who is human; it just prices existence. One honest agent pays a single bond for a long voyage, while a sybil army must fund a thousand separate lagoons of stake, each maturing slowly and each punished the moment the swarm links them. Authentic participation then becomes the costly signal to fake.
